subject: Urgent: StreamSight replacement for EdgeMetrics — cutover plan & evidence bundle
messages:
From: CloudStream Procurement <procurement@cloudstream.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 06 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: replacement of EdgeMetrics with StreamSight (impact + evidence request)

Hi Stephanie,

Quick heads up — CloudStream needs to move away from our current telemetry partner (EdgeMetrics) for ingestion and routing. The vendor is deprecating their agent and we've selected StreamSight as the replacement. We understand this is an outside-of-usual-window change for you, apologies for the short notice.

What we need from Redwood for vendor onboarding:
- Confirmation of data paths (ingest, storage, egress) and any cross-border flows
- Proof of encryption in transit and at rest for the new integration
- SOC-type summary or certs for StreamSight (if you proxy or host)
- Proposed cutover date and roll-back plan

Our target cutover is June 13, 2027. We can shift if your security/privacy reviews need more time, but procurement is asking for an evidence bundle by EOW (end of day Tue, Jun 8).

Thanks — please loop in whoever owns security and privacy.

— CloudStream Procurement
Procurement Team | CloudStream Inc
procurement@cloudstream.com
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: CloudStream Procurement <procurement@cloudstream.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 06 Jun 2027 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: replacement of EdgeMetrics with StreamSight (impact + evidence request)

Thanks for the heads up — Stephanie here (Legal & Partnerships at Redwood). We've looped in Security and Privacy. Quick clarifying questions before we start assembling anything:

1) Will StreamSight receive raw customer payloads, or will CloudStream perform tokenization/filtering before forwarding?
2) Is StreamSight hosted in AWS us-west-2 or a third-party region?
3) Is this an immediate permanent switch or a phased canary?

Ben/Kim/Marissa — can you take initial look at the ask? If we can get answers to the above today, we'll aim to collate a minimal evidence bundle by Tue EOD.

Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Legal & GTM Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, procurement@cloudstream.com
Date: Sun, 06 Jun 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: replacement of EdgeMetrics with StreamSight (impact + evidence request)

Stephanie / CloudStream — assigning Security intake. Short answers below and a checklist attached.

1) Data paths: if CloudStream proxies and filters, StreamSight will only receive obfuscated telemetry (no PII). If CloudStream forwards raw payloads, StreamSight will have access to raw request metadata including IPs and payload headers. Confirm which mode you plan to use ASAP.

2) Hosting: preliminary response from StreamSight says primary hosting in AWS us-east-1 with failover to us-west-2; that implies potential cross-region egress depending on failover. Need SLA-backed residency assurances in writing.

3) Cutover: strongly prefer phased canary (1% traffic -> 10% -> 100%) with KV-cache warmup and rollback markers. We need to validate TTLs and KV eviction behavior for latency-sensitive customers.

Attached: security-evidence-checklist.pdf (stub) — please review the checklist and return completed items.

Ben Carter
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Melissa Chan <melissa@cloudstream.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cloudstream.com, ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 06 Jun 2027 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: replacement of EdgeMetrics with StreamSight (impact + evidence request)

Hi Stephanie / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Answers inline below and attached evidence: streamSight-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC2 summary), dataflow-diagram.png (processing diagram).

1) Data mode: CloudStream will perform tokenization and remove any customer-identified fields prior to forwarding to StreamSight. We will provide a config snapshot showing the filter rules.

2) Hosting: StreamSight's primary tenancy is us-east-1; they have failover routes under customer-specific agreements that remain within the US. We will attach their regional residency note and an excerpt of the addendum.

3) Cutover plan: proposing a phased canary starting June 15 (1% traffic), ramp to 25% on Jun 17, full switchover Jun 20. Rollback: we will re-enable EdgeMetrics endpoint and purge StreamSight KV within 30 minutes if anomalies detected.

DocuSign: I've sent an addendum for StreamSight as a subcontractor to your legal contact (DocuSign link included).

Attachments: streamSight-soc2-summary.pdf, dataflow-diagram.png

Let me know if you need test credentials or a short technical call with StreamSight's SREs.

Best,
Melissa Chan
Vendor Ops | CloudStream Inc
melissa@cloudstream.com
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: CloudStream Procurement <procurement@cloudstream.com>, Melissa Chan <melissa@cloudstream.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 06 Jun 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: replacement of EdgeMetrics with StreamSight (impact + evidence request)

Appreciate the fast responses and the attachments — copied Security/Privacy notes below and next steps.

Ben: Security will validate the checklist and the SOC summary; can you confirm whether the residency note from StreamSight includes contractual residency guarantees (not just a marketing statement)? Also request a short (30-min) call with StreamSight SREs tomorrow (Mon) at 10:00 PT if possible.

Kimberly / Marissa: Please review DOCS (Drive link below) and confirm whether the tokenization description meets our DPA expectations for no-PII forwarding. If legal needs the DocuSign addendum redline, please flag ASAP.

CloudStream / Melissa: Requests for evidence bundle to include:
- Filter config snapshot (redacted acceptable)
- StreamSight SOC summary (we have it, Security will validate)
- Residency excerpt (signed)
- Temporary test credentials (read-only) and a contact for SREs
- Completed security-evidence-checklist.pdf (filled)

We can accept the proposed phased cutover (Jun 15 -> Jun 20) provided Security validates the checklist and Legal signs the addendum. If those complete by EOD Tue Jun 8, we can keep the timeline. If not, we will need to move the first canary by one week.

Action items assigned:
- CloudStream: share filter config snapshot and residency excerpt (Melissa) — due Tue EOD
- StreamSight: provide SRE contact and test creds (Melissa) — due Tue EOD
- Ben: review SOC & checklist, confirm residency guarantees — due Tue EOD
- Kimberly/Marissa: review DocuSign addendum and DPA alignment — due Tue EOD

Links: Evidence folder — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cStreamSightEvidence
DocuSign envelope — https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/12345MSAAddendum

I'll compile the final bundle for CloudStream after internal signoff. Thanks everyone — please acknowledge when you pick up your item.

— Stephanie Nguyen
